Johannes Brandstetter leads the "AI for Data-Driven Simulations" group at the Institute for Machine Learning, JKU - Johannes Kepler Universität Linz, with the aim of advancing data-driven simulations at industry scale. 
Additionally, he is a Co-founder and Chief Scientist at Emmi AI — a push towards the data-driven revolution in science and engineering.
